rule: One supplier, one listing, one direct route.
purpose: Define the first real supplier SaaS account path before backend auth, storage, billing, and admin queues are connected.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment collection, no rental commission, supplier keeps rental payment direct, and Heavyster earns listing SaaS revenue only.

monetization.phase_two_option: 1% confirmed-booking success fee only after Heavyster owns a proven booking workflow.

acceptance: A rental company can create a supplier account shell.
The supplier can add one company profile.
The supplier can create one paid-ready machine listing.
The supplier can attach one proof checklist.
The buyer can send one direct enquiry route.
The admin can approve or hold the supplier without rental payment records.
simplicity_rules: Show one calm next action at a time.
Do not expose backend complexity to buyers.
Keep supplier setup inside listing, proof, revenue, and lead steps.
Keep USD listing SaaS as the phase-one money rule.
Keep rental payments outside Heavyster until a real booking workflow is proven.
